items.description: bug-p12-add-ingredient-same-name: on an ingredient split across steps both "Add ingredient after <name>" buttons are announced with the same name; add the step to the label, as the Move buttons on the same line do (app/src/ui/IngredientTable.jsx:309-316). Test first.

bug-p12-start-after-narrowing-strands-draft: the Notebook New recipe entry stays open when the window narrows below 724, and Start then lands on the one-line desk page with a draft that cannot be opened. Mark decided the editor is a desk job (decide-p12-narrowing-closes-editor: leave as built), so the entry follows the same width rule as its New recipe button and is not offered below 724 (app/src/ui/NotebookPlace.jsx:144-147 and :236). Test first; reproduce in Playwright WebKit and Chromium against a scratch build.

bug-p12-focus-lost-across-724: Cancel leaves nothing focused when the button it returns to is not drawn at the current width. Case one: the Notebook New recipe entry after narrowing below 724 (NotebookPlace.jsx:195-197, :230). Case two: Record batch or Record tasting pens opened in the recipe head below 724, then widened to 724 or more, then Cancel (VersionRow.jsx:142-150, :477). Return focus to a control that is drawn at the current width. The Next version pen closing below 724 is decided leave-as-built (decide-p12-phone-focus-after-pen-close) and is not part of this. Test first; reproduce in Playwright WebKit and Chromium against a scratch build.

bug-p12-picker-cancel-focus-heading: the ingredient picker's Cancel sends focus to the heading's Add ingredient when the row that opened it has since moved into a step (also when unticked through Change ingredients, and when Cmd+Return in the grams opened the picker); resolve the row's current line at Cancel time and keep the heading as the fallback only when the row is gone (app/src/ui/CreationPage.jsx:334-342, :449-455). Test first.

bug-pen-saves-blank-lead-in: Next version saves a step with a blank lead-in or a one-sided target; the creation editor refuses both with Required. The version pen applies the same checks, with the same words (app/src/ui/Method.jsx). Cause not traced: trace it first, then a test that reproduces it, then the fix.

bug-pen-step-done-drops-focus: in Next version, Done and Remove this step on an open step leave nothing focused; Cancel already returns focus to Edit this step. Done returns focus to Edit this step, and Remove this step lands on a drawn neighbour (app/src/ui/Method.jsx). Cause not traced: trace it first, then a test that reproduces it, then the fix.

bug-p12-probes-accept-app-dist: copy the PROBE_DIST=app/dist refusal block from 12-phone-probe.mjs:44-59 into 12-tab-probe.mjs (:49-57) and 12-keys-probe.mjs (:42-52) in .planning/phases/12-showing-a-recipe-s-own-scales-and-problems-and-the-whole-loo/, and show each refuses app/dist. No app/ change.
